patterns.note: A minimalist, gallery-like grid layout where each project is presented as a distinct, often full-width or two-column block, with generous vertical spacing between them.
A clear typographic hierarchy uses large, bold sans-serif headings for project titles, paired with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels above them, creating a strong visual contrast.
The primary palette is stark black and white, serving as a neutral canvas that allows the vibrant and diverse colors within project imagery to take center stage.

The site features a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while all other content scrolls statically into view without additional animations or parallax effects.
Each project acts as a self-contained section, typically starting with a small descriptive label and a large title, followed by one or more large-format images or visual representations of the work.

technique_notes: The header navigation is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility throughout the scroll. Content sections are presented in a simple vertical stack, scrolling naturally without any reveal animations, fade-ins, or parallax effects. The design relies on static visual hierarchy and generous spacing to define content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are contrasted with small, uppercase sans-serif labels (~0.7x body) and standard body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing between project blocks, creating a sense of calm and focus for each piece of work.

standout: This site stands out for its extreme minimalism and gallery-like presentation, where the design itself recedes to let the diverse and impactful project visuals dominate. The lack of scroll-triggered animations or complex UI elements creates a stark, almost editorial feel, making each project feel like a distinct art piece.
